dynamic_line: 'The Behelit opened a place of sacrifice along the boundary where our worlds collided. Your Eclipse widened those wounds; it did not create this world's first catastrophe. I could not undo the sacrifice. I cut a way out while someone remained to save.'

dynamic_line: 'The Brand marks a survivor of the sacrifice. Its pain warns you when demons draw near; a stronger presence hurts more. At night, expect them to seek you out. Find cover and leave yourself a way to flee.'

dynamic_line: 'Apostles are monstrous beings with wills and bodies of their own. The God Hand stand apart: they preside over the sacrifice. Void and Griffith are not ordinary apostles. Do not mistake surviving an encounter for defeating them.'

dynamic_line: 'Some things you met before were projections: an echo formed around a Behelit. Breaking the echo leaves the true being untouched. The Behelit itself was real.'

dynamic_line: 'You lost your left hand and an eye in the Eclipse. The missing hand limits your grip; the lost eye narrows your perception. The Brand is another wound, and it will keep calling to the dark.'
